title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Tropical Sour Ice Blast Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Tropical Sour Ice Blast Nic Salt combines Pineapple and Kiwi with sour-sweet notes and a cooling finish. This sharp, tangy vape is brisk and refreshing, perfect for fans of fruity profiles with a sour edge. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for smooth throat hit and fast nicotine delivery. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
